review_candidates.title: Head – Global Transaction Banking, Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Result Areas The complexity of the role is very high, driven by: Size – Egypt is the largest IBG franchise, responsible for over 40% of IBG revenues Complexity – Highly volatile FX and interest rate environment Large team size Complex operating environment, regulatory requirements and competition for business Result Areas Strategy: Develop and execute a GTB strategy to support the growth of Cash Management, Trade and TBFX products, services, and solutions to assure a highly competitive offer
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Result Areas The complexity of the role is very high, driven by: Size – Egypt is the largest IBG franchise, responsible for over 40% of IBG revenues Complexity – Highly volatile FX and interest rate environment Large team size Complex operating environment, regulatory requirements and competition for business Result Areas Strategy: Develop and execute a GTB strategy to support the growth of Cash Management, Trade and TBFX products, services, and solutions to assure a highly competitive offering in line with leading competitors. Provide leadership and hands-on guidance to the Product and Sales teams to achieve business objectives. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Excellent communication skills, computer skills, creative and results driven Preferable MBA or Master Degree and university graduate / equivalent qualifications with at least 15 years experience in Transaction Banking.
